item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 18/Dec/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A replenishment of the dry monsoon will reach the coast of Guangdong today. It will be fine and dry over the region in the next couple of days. Temperatures will fall slightly and it will be cold over inland areas. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. The monsoon is expected to persist over southern China during the weekend and early next week. The weather over the coast will still be cool in the morning.

Date/Month: 18/12 (Wednesday)
Wind: Light winds force 2, becoming north force 4, force 5 offshore at night.
Weather: Fine. Cool in the morning and at night. Very dry during the day.
Temp range: 16 - 21 C
R.H. range: 35 - 70 per Cent
PSR: Low
